resources.string: Enter the relay this app connects to. The app page is secure (https), so the relay must use a trusted transport: https/wss (TLS), an .onion, or a loopback address (127.0.0.1) for local testing. A plain http:// LAN host is blocked by the browser. Only opaque ciphertext ever reaches the relay.
Enter a valid http:// or https:// address (host only, no path).

This device\'s Android System WebView is too old to run secure-chat. The app configures the encrypted client before any page code runs, and that step is unavailable here — continuing would load a client that cannot reach the relay and cannot mask passphrase entry. Update Android System WebView (or Chrome) from the Play Store and start the app again.
